description: This file contains helper methods related to rendering back-ends in the ANGLE graphics library, including functions for color manipulation, matrix handling, texture management, and sample position calculations.

classes.name: IncompleteTextureSet
classes.description: Manages incomplete textures used as placeholders in the rendering context.

classes.name: PackPixelsParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for pixel packing operations.

methods.name: PremultiplyAlpha
methods.description: Premultiplies the RGB channels by alpha.

methods.name: UnmultiplyAlpha
methods.description: Unpremultiplies the RGB channels by alpha.

methods.name: ClipChannelsR
methods.description: Clips color channels to only red.

methods.name: ClipChannelsRG
methods.description: Clips color channels to red and green.

methods.name: ClipChannelsRGB
methods.description: Clips color channels to red, green, and blue.

methods.name: ClipChannelsAlpha
methods.description: Clips color to alpha channel only.

methods.name: WriteUintColor
methods.description: Writes color as unsigned int to pixel data.

methods.name: WriteFloatColor
methods.description: Writes color as float to pixel data.

methods.name: GetFormatFromFormatType
methods.description: Retrieves the internal format based on GLenum format and type.

methods.name: ComputeStartVertex
methods.description: Calculates the starting vertex index for drawing commands, ensuring it fits within GLint range.

methods.name: GetVertexRangeInfo
methods.description: Determines the vertex range for draw calls, considering index data and base vertex.

methods.name: ClipRectToScissor
methods.description: Clips a rectangle to the current scissor rectangle if enabled.

methods.name: OverrideFeaturesWithDisplayState
methods.description: Overrides feature set based on display state.

methods.name: GetSamplePosition
methods.description: Retrieves standard sample positions for multisampling based on sample count.
